title: #8 Public Space
prompt: Some people believe that all cities and towns should have at least one large public open space. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: Some people believe that all cities and towns should have at least one large public open space.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Public open spaces are important for physical health and well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Public open spaces are important for physical health and well-being.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Public open spaces act as central meeting points, helping people build community connections.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Public open spaces act as central meeting points, helping people build community connections.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Some areas already have enough natural space, making it unnecessary to build one very large space, as smaller, local green areas are more suitable for the community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Some areas already have enough natural space, making it unnecessary to build one very large space, as smaller, local green areas are more suitable for the community.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, big parks are expensive to build and maintain, and the money would be better spent on other local necessities like schools or roads.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, big parks are expensive to build and maintain, and the money would be better spent on other local necessities like schools or roads.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the physical health benefits of public green spaces.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the physical health benefits of public green spaces.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the social and mental health benefits of public green spaces.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on the social and mental health benefits of public green spaces.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that while open spaces are beneficial, mandating a large one in every location is impractical and unnecessary.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that while open spaces are beneficial, mandating a large one in every location is impractical and unnecessary.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay provides two main arguments: first, that local needs should determine the size of the space, and second, that geographical and financial constraints make a universal requirement difficult to meet.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay provides two main arguments: first, that local needs should determine the size of the space, and second, that geographical and financial constraints make a universal requirement difficult to meet.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the importance of having at least one large public open space in every city and town, considering factors like urban planning, community well-being, and environmental sustainability.
keyArguments: Large public open spaces contribute to urban sustainability by improving air quality and supporting biodiversity.
They enhance community well-being by providing recreational areas and fostering social cohesion.
